output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is that the vulnerability allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, causing a denial of service to the user.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is that if the balance of the sender is just above the amount to transfer, it will underflow, causing the transfer function to revert.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is that if the sender's balance is just above the amount to transfer, it will underflow, causing the transferFrom function to revert.
